Collecting circumstances. According to Dr. Petar Beron, a participant of the British Speleological Expedition to New Guinea in 1975 (BSE), the collector of the holotype and the circumstances about its collecting remain unknown. The only certain fact is that the specimen was collected at the summit of Capella Peak, ca. 3960 m above sea level.
